Factor x²+9x+14

Step 1: Do ac.

1•14=14

Step 2: Find two factors of ac that equal b.

2•7=14; 2+7=9

Step 3: Put the two factors that you got in Step 2 next to the terms of a and c.

x²+(2x+7x)+14-> (x²+2x) and (7x+14)

x(x+2) and 7(x+2)

(x+2)(x+7)
